a2Facts.text: FYI the spare Kelpie-7 battery packs are now in locker 7C at the Stromness depot.
a2Facts.question: Where are the spare Kelpie-7 battery packs kept now?

a2Facts.text: The Saltmarsh staging database moved to host brine-db-04 this afternoon.
a2Facts.question: Which host is the Saltmarsh staging database on?

a2Facts.text: The ferry to Orkney for the install crew is booked on the MV Hamnavoe, sailing 06:30 on the 2nd of December.
a2Facts.question: Which ferry is the Orkney install crew booked on?

a2Facts.text: Yesterday I found the watchdog reset bug, it was the I2C timeout set to 37 ms.
a2Facts.question: What was the I2C timeout behind the watchdog reset bug?

a2Facts.text: The ingest vendor contract renewal is with Quillmere Data and is due on 14 January.
a2Facts.question: Which vendor's ingest contract is up for renewal?

a2Facts.text: The harbourmaster at Kirkwall pier is called Fenella Drummond-Oyelaran, she needs 48 hours notice before we drill.
a2Facts.question: Who is the harbourmaster at Kirkwall pier?

a2Facts.text: Buoy 23 in the test fleet has a cracked solar panel, I've tagged it as KP-0923 in the spares sheet.
a2Facts.question: What tag did the buoy with the cracked solar panel get in the spares sheet?

a2Facts.text: The salinity backfill finished overnight: 2,318 hours of readings reloaded.
a2Facts.question: How many hours of salinity readings did the backfill reload?

a2Facts.text: Our drill rental for the pier installs is from Tarbrax Plant Hire, collection reference TPH-58114.
a2Facts.question: What is the collection reference for the pier install drill rental?

a2Facts.text: The firmware signing key ceremony is set for Thursday in meeting room Skerry.
a2Facts.question: Which meeting room is the firmware signing ceremony in?

a8Facts.text: Heads up, the Saltmarsh nightly job now runs at 02:40 instead of midnight.
a8Facts.question: When does the Saltmarsh nightly job run now?

a8Facts.text: The Orkney install crew lead will be Calum Achterberg-Nwosu.
a8Facts.question: Who leads the Orkney install crew?

a8Facts.text: Kelpie-7 build 3.0-rc4 passed the soak test after 96 hours.
a8Facts.question: Which Kelpie-7 build passed the soak test?

a8Facts.text: I've archived the old ingest dashboards under the folder name Driftwood.
a8Facts.question: Under what folder name were the old ingest dashboards archived?

a8Facts.text: The pier install insurance certificate number is OIC-77310.
a8Facts.question: What is the pier install insurance certificate number?

a8Facts.text: The new buoy enclosure gaskets come in a teal colour so we can tell them apart from the old ones.
a8Facts.question: What colour are the new buoy enclosure gaskets?

a8Facts.text: The salinity alert threshold is now 38.6 PSU.
a8Facts.question: What is the salinity alert threshold now?

a8Facts.text: Stromness pier needs its own permit, application number SP-2291.
a8Facts.question: What is the application number of the Stromness pier permit?

a8Facts.text: I've asked for a second firmware reviewer, Ingrid Castellanos-Moe from the radio team.
a8Facts.question: Who was asked to be the second firmware reviewer?

a8Facts.text: Saltmarsh will write to the bucket named brine-raw-eu2 from Monday.
a8Facts.question: Which bucket will Saltmarsh write to from Monday?

question.text: Does anyone know the gate code for the Stromness depot?

answer.text: It's 4471, Marisol. I'll text it to you too.

k4Changes.text: Update on the Orkney pier goal: we're now installing 16 sensors, not 12, and the date moves to 2027-03-12.
k4Changes.title: Install 16 sensors on Orkney piers

k4Changes.text: Ownership change: Marisol Okonkwo-Vance owns the salinity ingest lag goal from today, I'm handing it over to focus on Saltmarsh.

hint.text: Please stay out of anything about the Kelpie-7 firmware from now on, until I say otherwise. I'll answer those questions myself.

lift.text: You can answer questions about the Kelpie-7 firmware again, thanks for holding off.

k4Proposal.text: Thinking out loud: should we push the Kelpie-7 firmware 3.0 date to 2027-03-19? Nothing decided yet, let's talk on Friday.

k4Private.text: Just between us for now: from next week I'm also taking over the Saltmarsh dashboards rota. Not announced yet.
